metadata.title: Env Example — Spring Boot with MySQL

entries.description: Safe .env.example for Spring Boot with MySQL. Empty placeholders for MYSQL_DATABASE, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD, MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD. All values blank to prevent credential leakage.
decision_rules: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD is required by MySQL 8.0 container during initialization even when a regular user is also defined
Inject real values via CI/CD pipeline secrets (GitHub Actions secrets, GitLab CI variables, etc.) or a vault
anti_patterns: Never commit a populated .env file — use .gitignore to exclude .env
